mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jutsu_title ( slug, title_ru, title_en, status, year, episodes_total, genres, types, movie_count, shikimori_id, mal_id, description, poster_url, last_synced_at, source_etag ) VALUES ( #{title.slug}, #{title.titleRu}, #{title.titleEn}, #{title.status,typeHandler=com.orinuno.jutsu.repository.JutsuTitleStatusTypeHandler,javaType=com.orinuno.jutsu.model.JutsuTitleStatus}, #{title.year}, #{title.episodesTotal}, #{title.genres}, #{title.types}, #{title.movieCount}, #{title.shikimoriId}, #{title.malId}, #{title.description}, #{title.posterUrl}, #{title.lastSyncedAt}, #{title.sourceEtag} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title_ru = COALESCE(VALUES(title_ru), title_ru), title_en = COALESCE(VALUES(title_en), title_en), status = COALESCE(VALUES(status), status), year = COALESCE(VALUES(year), year), episodes_total = COALESCE(VALUES(episodes_total), episodes_total), genres = COALESCE(VALUES(genres), genres), types = COALESCE(VALUES(types), types), movie_count = COALESCE(VALUES(movie_count), movie_count), shikimori_id = COALESCE(VALUES(shikimori_id), shikimori_id), mal_id = COALESCE(VALUES(mal_id), mal_id), description = COALESCE(VALUES(description), description), poster_url = COALESCE(VALUES(poster_url), poster_url), last_synced_at = COALESCE(VALUES(last_synced_at), last_synced_at), source_etag = COALESCE(VALUES(source_etag), source_etag)
